name: Mauritius

sources: Income Tax Act 1995 consolidated up to Finance Act 2026 with endnotes (mra.mu): s. 4, 16B, 16C, 27, First Schedule Part I (endnote 1052), Second Schedule Part II Sub-Part B, Third Schedule
Finance (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2025 (Act 18 of 2025) s. 26 (y), s. 66
Social Contribution and Social Benefits Act 2021 s. 4, First Schedule (as amended to 14/26)
unsupported: s. 27 (6) deeming of a dependant's income
NSF "basic wage" (allowances excluded) taken as the whole wage
registry_correction: MU: Income Tax Act 1995; 2025-26: 0 % to Rs 500 000, 10 % to Rs 1 m, 20 % above (FA 2025), plus a 15 % Fair Share Contribution above Rs 12 m (s. 16C); CSG 1.5 % / 3 % of remuneration.
headline: Mauritius built from the ITA 1995 and FA 2025: 0/10/20 % with dependant deductions and a 15 % Fair Share Contribution above Rs 12 m; the CSG switches from 1.5 % to 3 % of the whole wage above Rs 50 000 a month (+Rs 9 001 a year for Rs 12 more), and a spouse earning one rupee above Rs 110 000 costs the family Rs 22 000.

w5_pattern_a.added: NSF employee 1 % of the basic wage up to Rs 18,740 a month, nil at or below Rs 3,000 (Government pays), not deducted
